newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures rise on U.S. Q1 GDP data.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures rise on U.S. Q1 GDP data.

text.p: May 30 - U.S. debt futures rose on U.S. Q1 GDP data. GDP was revised to up 5.8 pct, vs avg estimates for up 6.0 pct and against original estimates of up 5.6 pct. Price index was revised to up 2.8 pct, and the implicit deflator was revised to up 2.2 pct, vs est of up 2.3 pct. Sept bonds rose to 109-06/32.
